name: low_vol_crash_v3_retail

filter.note: vol cap ranked WITHIN the day; composite signs frozen at the pre-2020 fit

portfolio.stagger: enter at most ceil(N/H)=1 name per session
portfolio.stop: none -- every stop tested reduces both mean and IR
portfolio.cost: one-sided, measured schedule by ADV band

chosen_on: development >= 2020 only; holdout not read at selection time

holdout_measured.note: third valid holdout read of the project. At 30 positions the seed-to-seed dispersion (sd 0.75) is 8x the development figure (0.09): which names you draw is a large part of the outcome, and a live trader gets one draw. The no-veto variant scored 1.31, so the composite still adds nothing once the vol cap is applied.
